newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SMH says four months business positive.
newsitem.headline: SMH says four months business positive.

text.p: Swiss watchmaker Ste Suisse Microelectronique et d'Horlogerie SA (SMH) said business in the first four months of the year had been positive and he was convinced 1997 would be a good year.
Nicolas Hayek, SMH president, told a news conference that he was convinced "this would be a good year".
While he declined to provide figures, Hayek added that he saw light at the end of the tunnel.
"The turnover figures in the first four months were positive," he said.
"The effects of 1997 investments will be noticed in a concrete fashion," he added.
Hayek said progess with the Smart car, which is being built with Daimler-Benz AG was according to plan and the first vehicles should be on offer early April 1998.
Nine to 12 months later SMH hopes to introduce a model with a special hybrid engine.
